reason: A debugging and learning plugin that makes DeepSeek Harness logical model-call context inspectable through categorized views, usage evidence, and sanitized retained captures.

summaries.zh: 用于调试和学习 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，可在专用界面中检查模型调用的提示词、消息、工具、选项及上下文组成。
summaries.en: A debugging and learning plugin for DeepSeek Harness that provides an inspectable view of model-call prompts, messages, tools, options, and context composition.

capabilities: Inspects logical agent-call context including prompts, conversation messages, tools, options, and reported usage
Displays categorized and estimated context composition in a dedicated UI tab
Stores sanitized per-session logical call captures locally with retention limits
